items.html: And when Bina and Tevuna became one Partzuf, it is found that since every Partzuf of Tevuna is the NHY of Bina, when Tevuna is a Partzuf by itself, its Yesod is very low; but when they are both one Partzuf, the Yesod of the totality of the Partzuf is more elevated, as above; and in this Yesod of the totality the coupling was made, and there the Mochin of the upper ZA were given, almost at the Peh of Tevuna. And then Aba and Ima coupled together, in the totality of all the Partzufim, in the secret of the pregnancy; and when the time of birth came, these Mochin came out from this Yesod of the totality.
